evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' carries urgent, high-arousal negative valence — a forceful directive to purge knowledge.
Imperative 'Remove' with absolutizing 'all' sustains the same urgent, high-arousal negative register as src-1.
Flat declarative delivered without intensifiers or imperatives — low-arousal, negative-valence resignation that closes the sequence.
